title: Normalized strict-system presentation interfaces
statement: For the prime, coefficient extension and pro-etale sequence categories of [def-pur-system-tensor-mate-arrows] and semilinear data of [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections], retain the identity reindexing, comparison with geometric inverse-image coefficients and the section-normalized open localization. Define a core comparison between any two normalized tensor-operation packages o and d: natural pullback, open-extension and tensor isomorphisms, the identity signed-total tensor-model equation for every K-flat pair, proper and open unit and counit equations, the canonical pullback-composition equation, and the tensor-pullback mu equation. It omits the projection, inverse-open-tensor and forward-open-tensor equations. Full comparisons extend the core and add those three equations; the identity-reindexing functor factors are suppressed definitionally. These are data interfaces only; no existence is asserted here. The slice functor is [def-pur-proetale-slice-to]; the valuation coefficients and universe transport are [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension] and [def-weil-size-convention].
